dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a new book to read. I'm interested in biographies, specifically. My budget is between $0 and $15, and I'm looking for something with a really high rating, like a 5 out of 5.
dialogue.agent:
I found two biographies with a 5-star rating:

*   **Ausgrenor: The First Novel in the Raising Up Pharaoh Series** - $14.95
*   **This Life as I See It: An Autobiography Based on True Historical Nonsense and Ridiculous Events of My Life** - $12.95

Would you like to know more about either of these?

products.title: Ausgrenor: The first novel in the Raising Up Pharaoh series
products.description: About the Author R. E. J. Burke is a former U. S. Marine, graduate of the University of Maryland and Yale Graduate School, aeronautical engineer, shipbuilder, banker, entrepreneur, author, and Christian speaker. His passion is the archaeology of the Chalcolithic and early Bronze Age in Western Asia, Eastern Europe, and Northeastern Africa, which led to his writing the six-novel Raising Up Pharaoh epic. Having lived in Asia, South America, the U.S. Midwest and on both coasts, he and his wife, Nancy, now live on the bluffs by the Potomac River in Shepherdstown, West Virginia. They have four adult children and six grandchildren, for whom they are very thankful. His favorite authors are Patrick O'Brian, J. R. R. Tolkien, Charles Dickens, Bernard Cornwell, C. S. Lewis, and Stephen R. Donaldson.

products.title: This Life as I See It: An Autobiography Based on True Historical Nonsense and Ridiculous Events of My Life

dialogue.user: "This Life as I See It: An Autobiography Based on True Historical Nonsense and Ridiculous Events of My Life" sounds interesting. What is that one about?
dialogue.agent: This book is about the author's adventurous life and learning to find peace through various struggles, told with humor. The reviews mention it's a compelling read, with one stating the author is an amazing person. It has a 5-star rating.

result.title: This Life as I See It: An Autobiography Based on True Historical Nonsense and Ridiculous Events of My Life
result.features: I was born in a Small town in Indiana and I could not wait move on to new adventures knowing there must be something more out there. I was in search of something but had no idea what. There were a roller coaster of events that altered the way I saw life. At the times of those struggles it was very difficult to understand what was the point. I can now look back with a sense of humor and understand that it all had a purpose. And really I wish I would not have needed an anvil to drop on my head multiple times to get that one moment of "Ah Ha" clarity in order to find my peace.

top_reviews.title: redemption
top_reviews.text:
a Native American shaman once asked
When was the last time you sang?
When was the last time you told your story?
When was the last time you listened to someones story?
Mary's story was a compelling read - lite/heavy. funny/sad - an eye opener!

top_reviews.title: Great book
top_reviews.text: I went to school with the author and she is an amazing person.
